# How to make stickman videos with AI: survival-choice reels drawn in code

**A topic becomes a 20-25 s stickman reel drawn in code: a jointed figure that walks and reacts, rules on screen, a two-choice ending, a $0.04 (4-credit) voice.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/4325c578-378d-4c43-ae53-3cc3218df1ea/file_5b22d8d7cb61.webp" alt="A white stick figure crouches in fear by a lighthouse door at 12:01 AM, under a DAY 1 counter and three keeper's rules, with the caption YOURS." width="480"></p>

Make a viral stickman video in code, with no video model: a jointed SVG stick figure (round head, two-bone arms and legs with fixed bone lengths, poses written as joint angles) acts out a survival-choice story, a POV story, a "fake friend vs real friend" contrast, a history explainer or a stick fight, with a DAY counter, rules that appear one at a time, word-timed captions, procedural sound and a two-choice "FOLLOW FOR DAY 2" ending, rendered to a 1080x1920 MP4 with HyperFrames. Ships the working rig (planted-foot walk, breathing idle, head turns, blinks, shock, crouch), script templates with word counts, the fixes for stiff head-only stickman animation, and a 24 s example whose voice cost $0.04 (4 credits). Use when someone asks for a stickman video, stick figure animation, a faceless stickman channel, a survival choice story, POV stickman, or wants to "make videos like the viral stickman reels". For Google Flow or Veo clip prompts use kaomei/stickman-video-director instead.

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill stickman-video                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills stickman-video --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 83 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

## Ask your agent

- "Make a 20-second stickman survival reel, 9:16: Day 1, you're the night guard at an empty aquarium, three rules, a choice at the end"
- "Make a fake friend vs real friend stickman reel about borrowing money, no voice, captions and sound only"
- "My stickman only moves its head and the limbs look stiff. Fix the animation in ./reel/index.html"
